> phone calls, form fills and closed revenue rather than impressions or keyword
> positions. Operating since 2012. Toll free: 1-800-481-8638.

- Search engine optimization (SEO)

- Sales training and protocol development

## Pricing

- No published flat rate. Price is scoped per engagement based on page count,
  competitive difficulty, current website condition, number of markets targeted,
  and whether content is written by the agency or supplied by the client.
- Free with no obligation and no credit card: SEO audit, competitor analysis,
  written 90-day scope, and quote. The client keeps all of it regardless of
  whether they engage.
- Market context is published at /omaha-seo-pricing/ using six named 2026
  industry surveys, which disagree with each other by more than three times.

## Timelines

- Measurable movement: typically 60 to 90 days
- Meaningful lead growth: typically 4 to 6 months
- Recommended minimum commitment: 6 months
- Website builds: 4 to 6 weeks for a focused service site, 8 to 12 weeks for
  larger or e-commerce projects

## Positions stated publicly on this site

- No agency can guarantee rankings in Google or placement in AI answers.
  Anyone offering such a guarantee is promising something they do not control.
- AI answer placement cannot be rank-tracked the way blue links can. Any
  precise "AI position" figure is a sampled estimate presented as a measurement.
- Google states that no special schema.org markup is required for AI Overviews
  or AI Mode, and that structured data should match visible page content.
- Google deprecated FAQ rich results in Search as of 7 May 2026. FAQPage remains
  a valid schema.org type that Google continues to parse.
- llms.txt is a community proposal. No major AI provider has confirmed using it
  as a retrieval or ranking input. This file exists because it is cheap, not
  because there is evidence it moves anything today.
- Google publishes three local ranking factors: relevance, distance and
  prominence. Distance cannot be influenced; the other two can.

## Articles

All published 21 August 2026. Every figure in them is attributed to a named
study with its sample size. No client results or case study figures appear.

- [Why Did My Google Rankings Drop?](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/why-did-my-google-rankings-drop/)
  (Strategy): three confirmed reporting artifacts that make healthy sites look
  damaged, the confirmed Google update timeline from August 2024 to May 2026,
  and how to identify which pages lost traffic. Free drop date checker.
- [How To Appear In Google AI Overviews](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/how-to-appear-in-google-ai-overviews/)
  (AI Search): Ahrefs found the overlap between Google top-10 ranking and AI
  Overview citation fell from 76% to 38% in a year. Covers correlation data
  across 75,000 brands and the KDD 2024 causal study. Free quotability grader.
- [How Long Does SEO Take To Work?](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/how-long-does-seo-take-to-work/)
  (Strategy): three to six months for first movement, six to twelve for lead
  volume, sourced from Ahrefs, Morningscore and Backlinko. Free progress checker.
- [SEO vs Google Ads: Cost Per Lead](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/seo-vs-google-ads-cost-per-lead/)
  (Strategy): Google Ads averaged $66.69 per lead across 13,474 campaigns.
  Organic has no fixed cost per lead because it is a fee divided by monthly lead
  volume. Free crossover calculator.
- [The Google Business Profile Checklist](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/google-business-profile-checklist/)
  (Local SEO): 22 points ordered by evidence, including a controlled study
  finding Google Business Profile Posts produce no ranking movement. Free
  scored checklist.
- [Do I Need A New Website Or Better SEO?](https://omahaseopros.com/blog/new-website-or-better-seo/)
  (Web Design): diagnosing whether the bottleneck is the website, the
  visibility, or something downstream of both. Free two-axis diagnostic.
